import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class GeneticEngineering {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String s = firstToken(reader);
        int[] boundaries = IntStream.concat(
                IntStream.of(0),
                IntStream.range(1, s.length()).filter(i -> s.charAt(i) != s.charAt(i - 1))
        ).toArray();

        long result = IntStream.range(0, boundaries.length)
                .map(i -> (i + 1 < boundaries.length ? boundaries[i + 1] : s.length()) - boundaries[i])
                .filter(len -> (len & 1) == 0)
                .count();
        System.out.println(result);
    }

    private static String firstToken(BufferedReader reader) {
        StringTokenizer tokenizer = null;
        while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            try {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }
        return tokenizer.nextToken();
    }
}
